High discharge flow rates Stainless steel hydraulic body to compatible Isocyanates. Easy to operate compact mounted on robust trolley Accurate fixed volume mixing ratio 1: 1 Double 3KW heaters for uniform and consistent heating Polyurea wrap scuff heated hose bundle 15 meter 12V- Flat Copper heating element hose for long term even heating without abrupt hot spots. Compatible with Air purge fusion gun, as well as Durable manual static mixture type spray gun.
